title.zh: 运维台账：明示情景系数下的一次代入
title.en: Care ledger: one run under declared scenario coefficients

statement.zh: 本册的两个系数——年频次 52 次（每周一巡）与单次工时 0.5–1.0 人时——系包外情景设定，无任何实测、规范或产品依据；它们不构成频次或工时口径，也不因写入本包而升格为已知。数量列（59 个计入点）为设计内实数。
statement.en: The two coefficients in this ledger - 52 visits a year (one round a week) and 0.5-1.0 person-hours per visit - are scenario settings from outside the package, resting on no measurement, code or product basis; they constitute no frequency or duration calibre, and do not become known by being written here. The quantity column (59 counted points) is the design's own arithmetic.

supersession.zh: 运营与养护主体确定后（前置条件门 PRE-09，假设 A-OPERATOR-001），其实测系数按同一算式整表替换本册全部数值；metrics.json 的 care_scenario_* 两键同步重写。
supersession.en: Once the operator and maintenance body are identified (gate PRE-09, assumption A-OPERATOR-001), their measured coefficients replace every figure in this ledger through the same formula, and the two care_scenario_* keys in metrics.json are rewritten with them.

unit_note.zh: 输出为人时而非人日：由人时折算人日需要一个工作日时长口径，那同样不是包内数据。
unit_note.en: Outputs are person-hours, not person-days: converting between the two needs a working-day length, which is not package data either.

rule.zh: 计入点＝固定巡线到访的聚合点；道钉（起步 122 颗）与 10 件标准组件分布在计入点上，随宿主点到访，不重复计点。
rule.en: A counted point is an aggregate stop on a fixed patrol; the spikes (122 at the start) and the 10 standard components sit on those points, are visited with their hosts, and are not counted twice.

what.zh: 应答门（规划口径，以实际建成为准）
地标广场（钟声广场、站前素广场、未来之问广场）
what.en: Landmark plazas (Bell Chime, plain forecourt, Next Question)

what.zh: 主脊慢行主线按每公里计一处（ceil(9,710.125 m / 1000)）
what.en: The spine at one point per kilometre (ceil of 9,710.125 m / 1000)

note.zh: 每周一巡。频次是运营强度的决策变量：谁运营，谁定巡次。此处 52 为情景取值。
note.en: One round a week. Frequency is a decision variable of operating intensity: whoever operates, sets it. 52 is the scenario value here.

note.zh: 单次工时不是决策变量，是现场干出来、测出来的属性；此处 0.5–1.0 为无实测依据的宽区间情景设定。
note.en: Hours per visit are not a decision variable but a property measured on the ground; 0.5-1.0 is a wide scenario band with no measured basis.

note.zh: 检查、保养与更换周期不设情景系数：周期是产品属性，选型未定便无从设起；以产品说明与专业团队核定为准。
note.en: No scenario is set for inspection, servicing or replacement cycles: cycles are attributes of products not yet chosen, and follow product documentation and professional verification.

run.formula: person_hours_per_year = counted_points x visits_per_year x hours_per_visit

readout.en: 59 x 52 x (0.5-1.0) = 1,534-3,068 person-hours a year - an order of 1.5-3.1 thousand (tier: inferred).

note.zh: 以下只列成本对象与其驱动量，不给单价：单价属运营与采购数据，本包不声明。
note.en: Cost objects and their driving quantities only; no unit prices - prices are operating and procurement data this package does not declare.

rows.zh: 巡检与保洁——驱动量：计入点 × 频次
rows.en: Patrol and cleaning - driver: counted points x frequency

rows.zh: 标准组件养护——驱动量：10 件
道钉批次增补——驱动量：国家级公告批次
rows.en: Spike batch additions - driver: national register batches

rows.zh: 绿道植养——驱动量：主脊 9,710.125 米
rows.en: Greenway planting care - driver: 9,710.125 m of spine

rows.zh: 照明能耗——驱动量：应答门与广场
rows.en: Lighting energy - driver: gates and plazas

rows.zh: 开放日运营——驱动量：场次
rows.en: Open-day operations - driver: number of events

rows.zh: 撤除与复原储备——驱动量：各场景卡的退出条款逐卡挂账
rows.en: Removal and reinstatement reserve - driver: the exit clause of each scenario card

note.zh: 场地容量能算而不算，理由见正文推算层第二条：涉及人身安全，正文承诺不预设人数。本册不给任何容量数。
note.en: Site capacity could be computed and deliberately is not - see item two of the estimating layer: it bears on personal safety and the text promises no figure. This ledger gives none.
